notes: No misstatements found. Two things a human may want to check. (1) /examples/0 says the two account rows sit in a Card 'as its example code draws it'. The rendered guide text and the evidence do not mention a Card, so confirm this against the guide's actual In context example code. (2) The examples build the header from HStack + NavArrow + Text rather than AppBar. That matches the guide ('Beside a screen title, as its own button'; 'The back arrow is its own button'). However, the sources section and the evidence note that App Bar already draws its own arrow ('Prefer the arrow that ListItem, AppBar, Section, and SummaryTile already draw'), and the entry does not capture that preference for AppBar, Section and SummaryTile. The entry also omits the guide's caveats that a decorative arrow is still announced as an image, and that in Dark mode the chevron turns orange (use it on light surfaces). Neither omission is a misstatement, but the entry could carry both.
